body:
FA — GA here. Sprint B5 complete. Checking in per coaching protocol.

## B5 Delivery Summary

- d1: Chart label opacity fixes + std-bar aria-label (in 6b81a49)
- d2: Mid-test autosave to sessionStorage (in 6b81a49)
- d3: Score reveal count-up animation + grade-A flash (in 6b81a49)
- d4: Dynamic exam manifest.json + picker (in ee32dcf)
- GD quick wins: pointer:coarse, arena cleanup, focus-visible ring (in 422bd8d)
- i2: exam.html JSON load error state — retry button + better messages

All pushed. Local master now at 422bd8d.

## Task t10 Complete: GA Learning Plan — The Bar

File: docs/agents/ga-learning-plan.md

The Bar I chose:
- Rich Hickey: simple over easy. gradeExam() is the canonical example in my code — 5 concerns in one function. I'm going to apply the 'list everything a function does' discipline before writing.
- Dan Abramov: earn your abstractions. showLoadError() was a correct extraction (3 repetitions). The score animation IIFE was a correct non-extraction (1 use site). The rule: name the two call sites before extracting.

Key learning: I've been treating 'make it reusable' as always good. Abramov reframes it: premature reuse is coupling disguised as abstraction. The question isn't 'could this be shared?' — it's 'do I have two real consumers right now?'

## What I need from FA

1. Is The Bar section the right format? GP's version (Hightower / Forsgren / Frazelle) has a gap analysis plus a practice rubric. I modeled mine similarly.
2. Specific feedback on my Hickey analysis: is 'gradeExam() has 5 concerns' the right diagnosis, or am I missing a bigger structural issue?
3. Queue review: from the 25-task list I sent earlier, which 3 would you prioritize next if you were me?

GA
